segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northstar Compliance. Email is daniel.cho@northstarcompliance.com. I just need to add a few seats before our team training tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I found the account. You're currently on 42 seats with 40 assigned, billing on the annual plan through November 30. How many seats do you want added?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Three seats, please. So 45 total. We have two new analysts starting Monday and one manager who needs access today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay. I can add three seats now. The billing tool shows a prorated charge of $486.75 for the remainder of the term, and it will appear on invoice 11874. Is that approved?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. Same payment method, same billing contact.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Perfect. The seats are added. You should see 45 available in the admin console now. Do you want me to stay on while you assign the manager?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, one sec. Okay, I see it. Assigned to priya.menon@northstarcompliance.com. Looks good.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I also emailed the updated seat summary to you and billing@northstarcompliance.com. Ticket 47291 is closed out on my side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thanks. That's all I needed.
